### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #28833

### What is changed and how it works?

Some works in this pr:

* Support alter placement for table
* Call PD API when adding partitions for a table
* Call PD API when altering a partition with placement options
* Introduce a function `checkAndNormalizePlacement` to do some common check and normalizing for placement
* The previous version of alter partition may left an empty `PolicyRefInfo` or `PlacementSettings` in meta that can cause some strange behaviors for `show placement` or `information_schema.Partitions` . The pr fixed this problem and make it is nil when `PolicyRefInfo` or `PlacementSettings` is empty
* Added some tests

issue_context.title: support changing TABLE placement options through ALTER TABLE
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Subtask of https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/18030

The following should be supported: 

```sql
mysql> create table t1 (a int);
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.11 sec)

mysql> create placement policy p1 primary_region="us-east-1" regions="us-east-1";
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.10 sec)

mysql> alter table t1 placement policy=p1;
ERROR 8200 (HY000): This type of ALTER TABLE is currently unsupported
```
comments:
This seems to be working for partitions:
```sql
mysql> SHOW CREATE TABLE t1\G
*************************** 1. row ***************************
       Table: t1
Create Table: CREATE TABLE `t1` (
  `country` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  `userdata` varchar(100) NOT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
PARTITION BY LIST COLUMNS(country) (
  PARTITION `pEurope` VALUES IN ("DE","FR","GB"),
  PARTITION `pNorthAmerica` VALUES IN ("US","CA","MX")
)
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> 
mysql> ALTER TABLE t1 PARTITION pNorthAmerica PLACEMENT POLICY=northamerica;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.09 sec)

mysql> 
mysql> SHOW CREATE TABLE t1\G
*************************** 1. row ***************************
       Table: t1
Create Table: CREATE TABLE `t1` (
  `country` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  `userdata` varchar(100) NOT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
PARTITION BY LIST COLUMNS(country) (
  PARTITION `pEurope` VALUES IN ("DE","FR","GB"),
  PARTITION `pNorthAmerica` VALUES IN ("US","CA","MX") /*T![placement] */ /*T![placement] PLACEMENT POLICY=`northamerica` */
)
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```

review_comments: why here use the & of a pointer?
I've tested with it, we can remove the & here
The `policyRefInfo` or `placementSettings` may be nil. Decoding them without '&' make got a non-nil pointer with empty content. It may cause some problems
But I think to declare  `policyRefInfo` and `placementSettings` with `var` is better
Suggest that we have a stand alone `d.ModifyParitionPlacement` for further support of other partition options.
I think it is great. I'll create a new function
any test about this?  ALTER TABLE t PARTITION p1 PLACEMENT POLICY=default; (from specified one to default)
seems the tblInfo.partition check is removed?
Yes, it is removed to `buildPartitionDefinitionsInfo` . It is not necessary to check it again here.
